profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I’m passionate about helping people grow and reach their full potential. Whether through coaching, mentorship, or sharing knowledge, I believe the best leaders empower others to succeed.

I enjoy building systems and solving complex problems, but what motivates me most is developing people and building high-performing teams. Seeing someone gain confidence, overcome a challenge, or achieve a goal is what drives me. 

I embrace new challenges, lead with empathy, and believe leadership is about serving others, fostering growth, and creating opportunities for success. 

Let’s connect, learn, and grow together.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Heavily into the Agile procedures and ceremonies, part of the e-commerce team, maintaining and developing new features for the retail web site, with a multi-language, multi-country web site, providing solutions to the front end using Javascript and Typescript on an MVC based website, based on ASP.Net with backend on .Net as services and complex interconnections to other services using containers, also with heavy use of cookies to maintain the user states and session.

Great experience working in big teams, using Microsoft Teams for meetings mostly due to social distancing, worked thoroughly with QAs and BAs to follow up the development on a 2-week sprints basis. As a Senior Developer, I have been provided assistance to Associates and mentored them when possible.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
In charge of the development of new features and the maintenance of existing ones, mainly working on ASP.Net with a heavy javascript functionality on the back end, and a broad set of microservices in the back end, using NServiceBus, Entity Framework, and NHibernate, with an orientation of Test Driven Development following the SOLID principles.  Working in an Agile environment and keeping the final users in the loop to validate all the new enhancements.
Participated in several side projects, from the upgrade of Kofax, software used to scan documents with the integration of Hummingbird, software used to store and version the scanned documents in the server.

Participated also in the home build software to keep track of the asset inventory, and the time-tracking system to monitor the time spent on each case.

Gained experience in government processes like SCRA, Pacer, and Skiptrace, and various services by Lexis Nexis by consuming the services as third-party services.

.Net Framework 4.1 to .Net Core
SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
In charge of the implementation of new Forms and Coverages for the different Lines of Business for a series of states. Making changes to the code using C # in a multi-layer environment, interacting directly with the business analyst team for the correct implementation of the expected requirement. Supporting in activities of leadership, organization, estimation and implementation of solutions. Automatizing processes for the optimization of the team effort.
With experience in the area of business related to personal, patrimonial, automotive and commercial insurance.
Used Waterfall and XP methodology to tackle the tasks based on the priority weights.

positions.title: Software Developer / Analyst
positions.locationName: San Nicolás de los Garzas Area, Mexico
positions.description: Worked in several projects in the client facility, used to make a full interact with final users to gather requirements, analyze it and develop Interfaces, Library Applications, Web Applications and Windows Form Based Applications. Used to modify Legacy systems and existing applications. With a great approach to face problems and urgent requirements, in a quite big area discipline from Industrial Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Logistics to Manufacturing and Production. Interacting with Automation departments to assure the correct interact between Level 1 HMI, Level 2 and Level 3 production layers.

positions.title: Software Developer / Analyst
positions.description: Worked in different projects achieving an approach to solve a new requirement requested for the Human Resource department, that covers the Technical Work Profile of all in general employee roles to grant a well spec recruiting scouting. Also participate in a side project called “Opportunities Committee”, what brings employees a forum to expose any improvement in any of industrial, administrative, logistic and production process, that gives to the client a process, safe-working security, energy and economic benefit with the implementation of that ideas.

positions.title: Software Developer / Analyst
positions.description: Worked in a project to generate a Calculation Engine for the Actuarial team, which was made intended to automatize the entry calculation process of the financial found of reserve needed by the client. Including from the data entry from distinct sources, with a huge amount of data to process, this project solved a big time consuming process that relieves a problem in the time of response to get the financial information to manage this critical data.

positions.title: Software Developer / Analyst
positions.description: Worked in 2 projects related, the main benefit was the exposing of financial information to the investors, who track the stock market changes around the market products that the financial service holds. Solving requirements to gather stock information, generation the calculations to projection and regression of the variation in the market and attending vendors’ requirements. Also a generation of complex algorithms to predict indicators in the market.

positions.title: Software Developer / Analyst
positions.description:
Secretary of Economina, Mexico					    	May 2005 - Aug 2006
Worked in the web application project what brings to the farmers the opportunity to sell his own assets (harvest) to another users in a massive quantity (entry harvest or by tonnage) giving the same farmers establish a Person to Person interaction to negotiate price and arrange a network trade if is needed. The Project was implemented nation-wide and help to activate the economy in the agricultural sectors of the country.

AON Risk, Monterrey, NL, Mexico					    	             Dec 2005 - May 2006
Worked in the support team of the platform used for the brokers of the company, with a good experience in the business rules of insurance services, like car insurance, life insurance, health insurance and patrimonial insurance. Used to interact with the reference user and final users to gather new requirements, also, involve the team (technical and functional) in the tests and validations. The supported portal handles the interaction of clients and display and gives the opportunity to purchase services on the fly.

volunteerExperiences.description: Led the club with a people‑first approach, creating a relaxed, safe, and encouraging environment where every member felt supported to grow. Focused on keeping the team engaged, aligned, and energized while helping individuals discover their own communication style. Encouraged members to speak with both passion and professionalism, fostering a culture of confidence, creativity, and continuous improvement.
